scope.question: Which source-defined catalytic-group perturbations retain a measured endpoint, and which apparent comparisons cannot be transferred?
scope.evidence: Projection of accepted source annotations; not new measurements, an independent evaluation, protein admission or evidence-tier promotion.
scope.selection: All rows of the accepted RA95 2013 kinetic and stereoselectivity tables and RA95 2017 kinetic panel; all six RA61 Table4 construct rows; all five KE59 Table2 pH-profile rows and its unassessed E230-control question. The beta-barrel extension includes three selected kinetic columns across two rows and all eight qualitative S4 arms, with three within-table ratios and one unassessed 16.1/8AH9 control-transfer request. Table 2 acceleration columns remain outside the selected packet; printed S/R factors remain source context. One source-reported RA95.5-8F methodol synthesis outcome and its two precursor comparator contexts extend product evidence with separate conversion, isolation and source-assigned composition records. A Siegel2010 Diels-Alder extension adds three parent kinetic parameters and two author-reported activity-reduction factors with unqualified assay/metric; product bounds remain separate source contexts. Human TKT 2019 adds all seven X5P/R5P kcat and all seven F6P k_forward entries plus all five existing NMR arms; other kinetic columns remain original source context, not extra common parameter records. POX 2019 adds all six variants for seven selected columns: pyruvate/DCPIP kcat and KM; MAP k_on, k_off and K_D_app; and anaerobic pyruvate/FAD k_app_max and K_0.5. The other three columns remain original source context, not missing data. Two complete 2013 RA95.5 and RA95.5-5 K83M/K210M four-cell panels also request multiplicative contrasts for kcat, printed kcat/KM and conflicted KM; the incomplete/unqualified RA95.0 panel supplies no square. KSI2014 preserves six probe-frequency and six compiled-turnover entries with one unassessed field/function context. Separate KimChoi1995 primary kinetics supplies all three Table1 constructs for kcat and KM, with four within-study ratios; other Table1 columns stay explicit source context. Kraut2010 adds all five rounded main-text kcat reduction factors for the pKSI Tyr16 mutant panel on5(10)-EST, with one assessed donor-control relation and unrequested arithmetic. Raymond2015 adds five selected TableI methodol initial-rate contexts for the full-length CaM/L105K pair and C-terminal cCaM/CaMWN/Ac-CaMWN controls, two genetic-background ratios and one source-assessed mechanistic control context. F92K/screen rows remain outside this question.
scope.arithmetic: Source-rounded central values, same-source assay and background only; reported efficiencies are never replaced by kcat/KM division.
scope.identity: Exact sequence/provider availability is separate from study-declared construct association and physical assay-specimen identity.
scope.mal_2012_extension: One Raj2012 L384A preparative outcome adds separate source-reported 65% conversion and 50% yield-after-purification records for ammonia addition to 2-(benzyloxy)-fumaric acid 1j yielding source-named 3-benzyloxyaspartic acid 4j. The latter is classified as isolated yield from the stated workup; the source literally labels it Yield. The exact assay sequence, numeric stereoselectivity, absolute product configuration, free-ammonia speciation and mutant-versus-WT effect remain unresolved; the Q73A/L384A qualitative failure context is retained without a computed comparison.
scope.limitations: No pooled rates, generic inactivity labels, causal residue assignments, full apparatus claims, microscopic coupling energy or design-success estimates. Forward product composition retains source-author configuration and unresolved retention mapping; strict ee bounds remain structured source context, not central-value comparisons. Diels-Alder activity-reduction summaries do not identify mutant kcat or product outcomes; strict product bounds and mismatched assays remain in context. TKT reporter-unavailable parameters, NMR qualitative presence / scoped nondetection and positive turnover remain different kinds; no selective partner-only intervention, crystal-to-assay identity or productive F6P full-cycle inference. POX analogue nonbinding differs from TKT reporter absence. MAP apparent equilibrium includes a covalent conjugate; positive pyruvate fitted rates do not establish oxygen turnover, an elementary-step rate or exact construct/preparation identity. Beta-barrel S4 arms are qualitative and belong to 16.2; main noninhibition prose conflicts with the plot and does not establish ligand-independent 16.1/8AH9. Exact deposited identity does not establish assay identity. KSI donor-control discrimination is limited to the named5(10)-EST panel. Double-mutant equilenin/phenolate structure and NMR are separate analogue contexts; cavity hydration/desolvation is source interpretation, not observed single-mutant turnover or a universal hydrogen-bond energy. Calmodulin residual methodol activity does not identify a lysine-covalent pathway; source-derived hydrophobic causality, diketone adduct identity and calcium allostery stay qualified. Full-length/domain, experimental/docking stereochemistry and TableI/Figure5 protocol distinctions are preserved.
